title: Pinned native BMP score and tie alignment
question: Does the pinned native BMP return scores and ranked passages consistent with the shared reference?
hypothesis: Returned positive scores agree with the independent uint64 oracle; every missing winner, tie difference or crash can be explained.
motivation: Test TASK-001 equivalence and characterize native ties, zero eligibility, empty queries and final queued block handling.

declared_changes.packaging: Retrospective organization only; raw native outputs preserved byte-for-byte.

scoring_contract.oracle: uint8 impacts; BMP-f32-ceil-cap32 query weights; uint64 accumulation; all documents eligible; score descending then numeric original ID ascending
scoring_contract.native_BMP: u16 score/bound path; strict heap admission; native result ordering retained and separately canonicalized

correctness_rule: CPU output equals every independent Python score. Native score errors, missing above-cutoff winners, missing positive scores at k=1000 and crashes are counted, retained and explained.
measurement_and_analysis_plan: 12 queries x 2 block sizes x 2 bound representations x 2 depths; retain native exit/score/missing-winner evidence.
success_rule: CPU output equals every independent Python score. Native score errors, missing above-cutoff winners, missing positive scores at k=1000 and crashes are counted, retained and explained.
failure_rule: Any unexplained discrepancy blocks treating native BMP as an aligned exact baseline.
next_if_negative: Create a separately labeled corrected variant and rerun this fixture, then common calibration data.
